title: Story Skills CLI result, apiVersion story/v2
$comment: The object `story <command> --json` prints. The envelope is the same for every command; `data` depends on `command` and is described under $defs/data-<command>. A failure before the command produced a result (a usage error, a missing project) has data null. Fields may be added within story/v2; renaming, removing, or retyping one changes apiVersion. story/v2 made diagnostics[].code the finding's rule code (story/v1, in 0.16.0, had the check name there) and added diagnostics[].check.

ok.description: True exactly when the command exits 0.

writes.description: Absolute paths of the files the command wrote.

file.description: The project file the finding is about, relative to the project root (a linked book's file starts with its folder); stdin for a finding about a passage piped to prose - or voices -; or null when it is about no one file.

chapter.description: The id of the chapter the finding shows up in, for the story continuity findings that carry one (docs/continuity.md lists them); null otherwise. An exemption's chapter key matches it.

message.description: The finding as the text output prints it, without the [code] the text output adds after a warning or a promoted warning.

code.description: The stable rule code of the finding, as docs/cli-reference.md lists it and story.md severity names it. A command that failed before producing a result uses usage-error, unusable-project, write-refused, or command-failed.

check.description: The check that raised the finding: validate, links, continuity, or the command name.

exemption.description: For a dismissed finding, the reason from continuity/exemptions.md, or "severity <code> is off in story.md" for a warning a story.md severity entry turned off.

exemptionIndex.description: For a dismissed finding, the index in the continuity/exemptions.md exemptions list of the entry that matched it (exemptions[i] in story validate's messages), or null when a story.md severity entry turned it off.

skipped-checks.description: Checks the story's language pack has no word lists for, so they did not run; empty for English.

check.description: The skipped check, such as filter-words or speech-tags.

missing.description: The word lists the pack lacks.

message.description: The note the text output prints.

data-check-all.$comment: errors, warnings, and dismissed count the diagnostics: each finding once, and with strict every warning as an error. checks summarizes each check's own result, as story validate, links, and continuity report it.

status.description: The book's story.md status as written, or null when unset.

doctor-fix.description: Only on doctor --fix: the safe repairs it applied. actions, checks, and diagnostics are the diagnosis made after them.

dryRun.description: True for --dry-run, which changed nothing: the repairs ran on a copy of the project, and writes is empty.

codes.description: The finding codes that called for this repair.

stopped.description: Why a repair could not run (a file that does not parse), after which no later repair was tried; null when every due repair ran.

changes.description: Every change the repairs made, sorted by path.

path.description: Relative to the project root, with / separators.

data-report.$comment: series, bookNumber, genre, subGenre, status, pov, tense, and schemaVersion are copied from story.md frontmatter as written, or null when unset.

unit.description: The book's count unit: characters for Chinese and Japanese, or story.md count-unit; words otherwise.

targetCharacters.description: story.md target-characters in a book counted in characters, else null.

characterCount.description: The manuscript's prose (not the characters entity count) in characters, or null in a book counted in words.
The chapter's prose in characters, or null in a book counted in words.

chapter.description: The target's chapter id: the target itself, or the scene's chapter.

estimatedTokens.description: The estimated tokens of the included items, at ceil(words * 4 / 3) each.

sections.description: Every section in priority order, each with every candidate item; an item's included says whether it fit the budget.

omitted.description: The items left out to fit the budget, in priority order.

source.description: The project files the item draws on, comma-separated.

warnings.description: Project files left out because they failed to parse; also reported as diagnostics.

id.description: The kind and id, such as character:mara-quill or scene:chapter-02-scene-01.

source.description: The project files the item draws on, comma-separated.

learnedIn.description: The chapter id it was learned in, or empty for pre-existing knowledge.

audience.description: reader: already shown to the reader, or known before the book. character: known in story time from a chapter the reader has not reached; do not reveal.

state.description: The character's frontmatter with every progression up to and including the chapter applied, and progressions left out.

changes.description: The progressions applied by the chapter, oldest first.

from.description: The chapter the change takes effect from.

previous.description: The value the change replaced; absent when the field was not set before.

data-write.$comment: The write commands. The rest of data is the command's result: kind, id, and file (relative to the project root) for add, rename, remove, move, split, and merge, plus oldId for rename and move, and prose for rename --prose ({ edits: [{ file, line, endLine, column, from, to }], aliases, shared }); newId, title, scenesMoved, and renumbered for split, whose file is the new chapter; mergedId, scenesMoved, and renumbered for merge; chapters and total for wordcount.

dryRun.description: True for a --dry-run, which changed nothing: changes lists what the command would do, and writes is empty.

changes.description: Every file the command created, updated, or deleted, and every folder it made, sorted by path.

name.description: The existing name or alias matched: a character's given name when the match is on it.

full.description: The whole name the matched name belongs to.

file.description: The entity's file, relative to the project root, with / separators.

names.description: One entry per candidate name, in the order given.

status.description: taken with a clash, check with only look-alikes or shared initials, else clear: the word the text output prints.

clashes.description: Existing names it clashes with; each is a name-clash error.

lookalikes.description: Existing names it looks like; each is a name-look-alike warning.

initials.description: Major characters whose given name shares its initial; each is a name-shared-initial warning.

data-mentions.$comment: With no kind and id (mode audit), kind, id, names, chapters, and matches are null and the findings are the diagnostics.

names.description: The names looked for: the entity's name, a character's given name, and its aliases.

chapters.description: Each drafted (not outline) chapter, in chapter order, whose prose names the entity or whose frontmatter lists it.

file.description: The chapter file, relative to the project root, with / separators.

listed.description: Whether the chapter's frontmatter lists the entity (pov, characters, or mentions for a character; locations for a location; mentions for an artifact), or null for a kind chapters do not list.

matches.description: Each place the prose names the entity, in chapter and text order.

line.description: The line in the chapter file, counting its frontmatter.

text.description: The name as the prose writes it.

excerpt.description: The line around the match, trimmed.

data-compare.$comment: In chapters mode, anchors is null; with --anchor (anchors mode), chapters and the four totals are null.

label.description: "git ref <ref>", the absolute path of the --against project, or "snapshot <id>".

before.description: Words in the earlier draft; 0 for an added chapter.

after.description: Words now; 0 for a removed chapter.

unchanged.description: The share of paragraphs unchanged, from 0 to 1.

movedFrom.description: The chapter's id in the earlier draft when it moved, else null.

to.description: The current label, for an unchanged or edited paragraph.

similarity.description: From 0 to 1, for an unchanged or edited paragraph.

excerpt.description: The opening words of a paragraph not found in the current text.

status.description: pending, in-progress, or done (as story.md records it).

focus.description: What a default pass looks for; null for a custom pass.

checks.description: The commands that help with a default pass, pointed at the project; null for a custom pass.

next.description: The pass in progress, else the first not done; null when all are done or none are recorded.

notes.description: The note: lines the text output prints, such as a custom pass that may be a typo.

dryRun.description: True for a --dry-run, which changed nothing: changes lists what the command would do, and writes is empty.

changes.description: Every file the command created or updated, and every folder it made, sorted by path; empty when it wrote nothing.

outFile.description: The absolute path --out wrote (or, with --dry-run, would write), else null.

dryRun.description: True for a --dry-run, which changed nothing: changes lists what the command would do, and writes is empty.

changes.description: Every file the command created or updated, and every folder it made, sorted by path; empty when it wrote nothing.

data-snapshot.$comment: story snapshot <name> reports the snapshot taken, as a write command does (dryRun and changes); story snapshot --restore <name> reports data.restored; story snapshot --list reports data.snapshots.

id.description: The kebab-case id, the snapshot's folder name.

created.description: When the snapshot was taken, an ISO 8601 UTC time.

characters.description: Only in a project counted in characters.

dir.description: The snapshot folder, relative to the project root: .snapshots/<id>.

replaced.description: True when --force replaced a snapshot of the same name.

restored.description: The snapshot put back: its name as taken and its id.

safety.description: The snapshot of the project as it was, taken before the restore (before-restore-<id>-<n>); null when the project already matched and nothing changed.

created.description: Markdown files written back that the project did not have, relative to the project root.

updated.description: Markdown files rewritten to the snapshot's text.

deleted.description: Markdown files the snapshot does not have, deleted from the project.

reindexed.description: False when nothing changed, or when a restored file does not parse, so the registries were left for story reindex after the fix.

changes.description: Every file created, updated, or deleted, the safety snapshot's and the registries reindex rebuilt included.

snapshots.description: Oldest first; a folder without a readable snapshot.json comes last, with a null date and counts.

from.description: The first chapter shown, after --from; null when the book has no chapters.

to.description: The last chapter shown, after --to; null when the book has no chapters.

total.description: Chapters in the whole book, shown or not.

chapters.description: The columns, in chapter number order.

hook.description: The chapter's hook, or an empty string.

outcomes.description: The outcomes of the chapter's scenes, in scene order; sequels and scenes with no outcome are left out.

rows.description: Arcs in the order the whole book first advances them, then arcs no chapter advances, then ids no arc file defines.

name.description: Null for an id no arc file defines.

status.description: Null for an id no arc file defines.

known.description: False when chapters or scenes advance an arc id with no file in plot/arcs.

cells.description: One cell per entry in chapters, in the same order: true when the chapter or one of its scenes lists the arc in arcs-advanced.

kind.description: The kind listed, by its plural name.

where.description: The --where filters, in the order given; an item matches only when it matches every one.

op.description: eq for key=value, ne for key!=value, present for key, absent for !key.

value.description: The value compared; null for present and absent.

total.description: Files of the kind, matched or not.

items.description: The matches in book order: chapters by number, scenes by chapter and scene, matter by order, the rest by file name. Empty when a project file fails to parse.

file.description: The file, relative to the project root, with / separators.

title.description: The title, or the name for characters, places, and other bible entries, or the term for glossary terms.

fields.description: The frontmatter value of each filtered key, as written; null when the file does not set it.

budget.description: The word budget: 500 for one page, 1500 for three.

sections.description: The text under each arc heading, in arc order; an arc a truncated synopsis lost is left out.

text.description: The synopsis markdown, as printed or written.

outFile.description: The absolute path --out wrote (or, with --dry-run, would write), else null.

dryRun.description: True for a --dry-run, which changed nothing: changes lists what the command would do, and writes is empty.

changes.description: Every file the command created or updated, and every folder it made, sorted by path; empty when it wrote nothing.

label.description: The --against text as given, or "git ref <ref>".

minWords.description: The shortest shared run reported, after --min-words and story.md cli-defaults.

from.description: Paragraph label of the passage's first word, as the review copy labels it (ch03-p12).

text.description: The shared words as written in the chapter; paragraphs are joined with " / ".

file.description: Path from the working directory, or <ref>:<path> for a git ref.

from.description: A chapter label (ch07-p4) for a story project, or p4 for a plain file.

language.description: story.md language as written (en when unset), which picks the language pack.

baseline.description: The profile built from style-sheet.md samples, or null when there are none or --baseline false.

samples.description: Each sample document, relative to the project folder.

filterPerThousand.description: Null when the filter-word check is skipped for the language.

adverbsPerThousand.description: Null when the adverb check is skipped for the language.

signatureWords.description: Null when signature words are skipped for the language.

usable.description: False when the samples hold too little narration to compare with; the fixed limits then apply.

thresholds.description: The warning limits the run used, after --max-filter-words, --max-adverbs, --max-bookisms, and story.md cli-defaults.

sample.description: Present when the style sheet names this chapter as a sample: it is part of the baseline, so no prose-baseline-* drift is reported for it.

baseline.description: Present when a baseline is on: the chapter's figures on the baseline's scales.

similarNames.description: Pairs of characters whose first names a reader could confuse.

language.description: story.md language as written (en when unset), which picks the language pack.

contractions.description: Per 100 words, or null when the contraction count is skipped for the language.

characterCount.description: The chapter's prose in characters, or null in a book counted in words.

unit.description: The book's count unit: characters for Chinese and Japanese, or story.md count-unit; words otherwise.

medianCharacterCount.description: The median chapter in characters, or null in a book counted in words. The long and short chapter findings use the median in the unit.

cells.description: One cell per entry in chapters, in the same order.

data-progress.$comment: target, percent, remaining, deadline.perDay, lastSession.since, and pace are in unit; words is the word count in every book.

characterCount.description: The logged manuscript in characters, or null in a book counted in words.

unit.description: The book's count unit: characters for Chinese and Japanese, or story.md count-unit; words otherwise.

characterCount.description: The manuscript in characters, or null in a book counted in words.
The chapter's prose in characters, or null in a book counted in words.
The session's manuscript in characters, or null in a book counted in words.

daily.description: Daily writing from the session log, in unit: a day's words are the gain since the session logged before it, and today's are measured from the manuscript now.

target.description: story.md daily-target-words (daily-target-characters in a book counted in characters), or null.

writingDays.description: story.md writing-days, Monday first, or null for every day.

scheduled.description: Whether today is one of the writing days.

written.description: Gained since the last session before today, or null with none logged.

weeks.description: The last --weeks weeks (default 4, 1 to 52), Monday to Sunday, oldest first, ending with the current week.

dryRun.description: True for a --dry-run, which changed nothing: changes lists what the command would do, and writes is empty.

changes.description: Every file the command created or updated, and every folder it made, sorted by path; empty when it wrote nothing.
